description: This file defines the AdminUserAPI class which extends AbstractInstallerRestController. It provides API endpoints for managing administrator user data during installation, including creating (POST) and retrieving (GET) admin user information, with handling of request validation and state management.

classes.name: AdminUserAPI
classes.description: API controller for managing admin user data during installation process, supporting GET and POST methods.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create or update admin user data, validating input fields, updating state, and returning user info or errors.

methods.name: checkAndGetField
methods.description: Utility method to verify presence and non-emptiness of a request field, throwing an exception if validation fails.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve stored admin user data and registration consent status.
